IDX={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AA)}
def smat(s1,s2):
    i1=np.array([IDX.get(c,-1) for c in s1]);i2=np.array([IDX.get(c,-1) for c in s2])
    M=np.full((len(s1),len(s2)),-1.0);o1=i1>=0;o2=i2>=0
    M[np.ix_(o1,o2)]=B62[np.ix_(i1[o1],i2[o2])];return M
def nw(Sm,go=-11.,ge=-1.):
    n,m=Sm.shape;NEG=-1e9
    Mx=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    Mx[0,0]=0.;Ix[1:,0]=0.;pX[1:,0]=1;Iy[0,1:]=0.;pY[0,1:]=2;ar=np.arange(m)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        st=np.vstack([Mx[i-1,:-1],Ix[i-1,:-1],Iy[i-1,:-1]]);k=np.argmax(st,0);Mx[i,1:]=st[k,ar]+Sm[i-1,:];pM[i,1:]=k
        st=np.vstack([Mx[i-1,1:]+go,Ix[i-1,1:]+ge,Iy[i-1,1:]+go]);k=np.argmax(st,0);Ix[i,1:]=st[k,ar];pX[i,1:]=k
        mx=Mx[i];ix=Ix[i];iy=Iy[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            a=mx[j-1]+go;b=ix[j-1]+go;c=iy[j-1]+ge
            if a>=b and a>=c: iy[j]=a;pY[i,j]=0
            elif b>=c: iy[j]=b;pY[i,j]=1
            else: iy[j]=c;pY[i,j]=2
    i,j=n,m;st=int(np.argmax([Mx[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]]));pr=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0: pr.append((i-1,j-1));st=pM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1: st=pX[i,j];i-=1
        else: st=pY[i,j];j-=1
    return pr[::-1]

KEY=[(13,'G','G/G','cofactor'),(14,'Y','-/Y','cofactor'),(15,'G','G/G','cofactor'),(16,'R','N/A','cofactor'),

 (43,'D','I/-','cofactor-2prime'),(75,'A','A/A','cofactor'),(76,'H','S/S','cofactor'),(79,'I','A/A','cofactor'),

 (127,'A','A/A','both'),(152,'T','-/K','substrate'),(189,'R','R/-','cofactor'),(190,'N','-/N','substrate'),
 (192,'N','N/N','both'),(193,'T','V/V','both'),(223,'H','-/N','substrate'),(225,'V','-/H','substrate'),

for org,(acc,L,sq) in best.items():
    pr=nw(smat(HUM,sq)); m={i+1:sq[j] for i,j in pr}
    idents.append(100*sum(1 for i,j in pr if HUM[i]==sq[j])/len(pr))
    for p,_,_,_ in KEY: obs[p].append(m.get(p,'-'))
for p,hres,anc,site in KEY:
    v=[c for c in obs[p] if c!='-'];c=Counter(v)
    anc_set=set(x for x in anc.replace('/','') if x!='-')
    rows.append(dict(pos=p,human=hres,anc=anc,site=site,n=len(v),
        pct_human=100*c.get(hres,0)/len(v), matches_prok=hres in anc_set,
        pct_anc=100*sum(c.get(a,0) for a in anc_set)/len(v), iso2=p in iso_keep))
T=pd.DataFrame(rows)
